tasks.title: Beeper code → bit number
tasks.solution: tryArm() calls beeperWarningBeeps(ffs(flags)): the code N = 5·long + short, and ffs() numbers bits from one, so bit = N − 1. Look up the name in the table for your version: up to and including bit 24 the 2025.12 and 4.5 tables match, beyond that they do not (ARM_SWITCH: bit 28 in 2025.12, bit 25 in 4.5).

tasks.title: The throttle from which “normal flight” accumulates
tasks.solution: calculateThrottlePercent(): percent = (rc − min_check)·100 / (2000 − min_check). Hence rc = min_check + p·(2000 − min_check)/100. With the defaults (1050, 20 %) that is 1240 µs. Without a stick deflection ≥ 15 % time accumulates only from twice the percentage.

tasks.title: The yaw spin recovery threshold in AUTO mode
tasks.solution: initYawSpinRecovery(): threshold = max_yaw + max(max_yaw/4, 200), then a limit of 500…1950 °/s. Up to 800 °/s the margin is 200 °/s, above that — 25 %; with max_yaw ≥ 1560 °/s the threshold hits 1950. The mode exits below the threshold − 100 °/s for longer than 20 ms.

tasks.title: Will the ANGLE check pass
tasks.solution: The tilt is the angle between the body vertical and the gravity vector: cos θ = a_z / |a|. isUpright() compares cos θ with cos(small_angle): arming is allowed at θ < 25°. For 25° the ratio a_z/|a| = 0.906.
